release_criteria: For editorial acceptance: one substantive reviewer opinion per article version covering factual claims, sources, genre, image and editorial quality; do not duplicate factual and editorial approvals.

For visual acceptance: reuse public 390/1440 theme checks and reconstructed renders; check actual private draft only where material rendering risk remains, especially tables and featured caption; no six-by-two blanket screenshot requirement.
For publishing: preserve existing trusted independent Gate authorization, immutable canonical snapshot/version checks, signed approval and WordPress readback; never fabricate approval.

For operational resilience: validate backup restore and replay/rollback as a separate hardening milestone, not an automatic blocker for editorial review or saving drafts; assess risk before any unattended production rollout.
TinyFish HTTP429 is a tooling issue, not a publication-quality failure; do not retry unchanged or weaken global security.
